disclaimer: Badges are in-app recognition of practice progress. They are not ABRSM certificates, grades or results, and ABRSM does not endorse this app.

achievements.title: Treble line reader
achievements.description: Show you can read the five treble-clef line notes: enough varied, first-try answers without hints.

achievements.title: Two-clef reader
achievements.description: Read notes in both the treble and the bass clef: proficient with the treble line and space notes and the bass clef.

achievements.title: First four scales
achievements.description: Show you know the C, G, D and F major scales: proficient with the scale pattern, G and D major, and F major.

achievements.title: Triplet master
achievements.description: Master Grade 2 triplets: independent evidence over several days, including a successful review.

achievements.title: Compound-time challenger
achievements.description: Succeed in the Grade 3 compound-time unit challenge.

achievements.title: Chromatic speller
achievements.description: Spell the chromatic scale correctly with varied first-try answers.

achievements.title: Cadence challenger
achievements.description: Complete the Grade 5 harmony unit challenge, which includes the cadence tasks.

achievements.title: Grade 1 complete (practice assessment)
achievements.description: Pass the Grade 1 practice assessment. Finishing lessons or earning XP never awards this. It is an in-app practice badge, not an ABRSM result.
